title: Squirrel Sightings (Optional) Part c)
body: Alankrita is interested in how many squirrels were sighted at every location during every month. Create a table called sightings where each cell contains the number of squirrel sightings that occurred in $$2023$$ at each location during each month. Note: Each row should be in a different location.\n##figure1.gif

figureAlts.figure1.gif: A table of squirrel sightings with columns for Squirrel ID, Location, Day, Month, and Year. Row 1: 2937, Wheeler Hall, 17, 3, 2024; Row 2: 8421, East Asian Library, 28, 9, 2022; Row 3: 472, Etcheverry Hall, 7, 1, 2024; Row 4: 239, Campbell Hall, 4, 10, 2023; Row 5: 2937, Moffitt Library, 7, 6, 2021.
